text: A whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may keep you from tripping for days afterward. A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and even improve the trip without ending it. But it takes only a little more than a nibble to end the trip, so I use it for nausea only when the person is okay with their trip possibly ending.
reader: somebody sitting with a friend whose psychedelic trip has gone bad enough that they want it over, or whose nausea won't stop, deciding whether to give beach morning glory and how much
